# Contenedor con SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=prod y las variables de la base, contra el PostgreSQL 16 del job
docker run -d --name mi-app-prod --network host -e SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=prod -e DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/appdb -e DATASOURCE_USER=appuser -e DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=apppass mi-spring-app:local
until curl -sf localhost:8080/actuator/health > /dev/null; do sleep 2; done
docker logs mi-app-prod 2>&1 | grep -E 'profile is active|Started PedidosApplication'

# Checkpoint 1 (Parte 2): en prod health responde UP sin detalles, e info muestra la version
curl -s localhost:8080/actuator/health -w '  HTTP %{http_code}\n'
curl -s localhost:8080/actuator/info -w '  HTTP %{http_code}\n'
# ...y beans y env no estan expuestos
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '/actuator/beans -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' localhost:8080/actuator/beans
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '/actuator/env   -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' localhost:8080/actuator/env

# La API contra PostgreSQL: la tabla la crea db/schema-postgresql.sql y Hibernate la valida
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/pedidos -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"clienteEmail":"ana@correo.com","tipoCliente":"MAYORISTA","subtotal":100000}' -w '  HTTP %{http_code}\n'
PGPASSWORD=apppass psql -h localhost -U appuser -d appdb -c 'SELECT id, cliente_email, tipo_cliente, total, estado FROM pedido'

# El HEALTHCHECK de la imagen marca el contenedor como healthy
until [ "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' mi-app-prod)" = healthy ]; do sleep 5; done
docker ps --filter name=mi-app-prod --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}'
docker rm -f mi-app-prod
